hero.heading: Shred A Billion Roblox Wiki: Official Game Link and Starter Guides
hero.lead: Play Shred A Billion on Roblox through the official experience page for Blue Chip studios. Before launching, check that the creator line reads Blue Chip studios so you know you have the right listing. Your first goal is to use the hand vac to collect bills, then turn the bundles into coins at the shredder. Later, the golden key opens the gold vault and starts a separate heist objective. The steps and milestone table below show where to start, what to watch for at night, and what to try next. This site covers the Roblox experience Shred A Billion by Blue Chip studios, not the PC/Steam game with the same name.

sections.heading: Turn Your First Load of Bills Into Coins
sections.intro: For your first run in Shred A Billion, take the starter hand vac into the bank vault and pick up a small load of bills. Bring the cash bundles to the shredder and feed them in. You earn coins for each bundle you shred, not just for picking up the bills.
paragraphs: Make the shredder your first checkpoint rather than trying to clear the vault in one trip. Once you've turned in a load, head back for more bills. Repeating those trips earns the coins you can put toward vacuum upgrades.

The milestones below separate the tool you start with from the ones you can work toward. The later names aren't a required purchase order, so check the in-game requirements for the tool you want before spending your coins.

sections.heading: Watch for Monsters After Dark
sections.intro: Monsters appear at night in Shred A Billion. If you’re still getting used to collecting bills, aim for a short first run rather than planning to stay out after dark.
paragraphs: Give yourself a simple stopping point: pick up a small batch of bills, then head back instead of looking for one more pile. You don’t need to collect every bill you see on your first outing.

sections.heading: Find the Golden Key to Start the Gold Vault Heist
sections.intro: Dig to find the golden key, then use it to open the gold vault.
paragraphs: Once the vault is open, load the gold onto carts and ride with it to the hideout. That cart trip is the next objective after opening the vault, and it takes you to a different destination from your earlier cash runs.
The heist leaderboard ranks the fastest runs. On your first attempt, focus on getting the gold to the hideout, then check how your time compares with the leaderboard entries.

sections.heading: Play With Friends or Check the Roblox Group Offer
sections.intro: You can play Shred A Billion with up to three friends. Count yourself when planning your first session: that’s room for four players, including you.
paragraphs: The Roblox listing separately advertises 100 coins for joining the group. If you’re interested in the offer, check the official game description for the group invitation rather than looking for a redemption code. The listing doesn’t say when or how the coins are delivered.

faq.question: What is the official Roblox link for Shred A Billion?
faq.answer: Use the official Roblox experience page. If you find the game through search instead, compare the address with this direct link rather than relying on the title alone. Blue Chip studios is the creator credit to look for before you open the experience.

faq.question: What should I focus on first in Shred A Billion?
faq.answer: Aim to earn your first coins with the hand vac before worrying about which vacuum to buy next. Take a small load all the way to the shredder: picking up bills is only the collection step, while shredding the bundles is what earns you coins.

faq.question: Can I join my friends in Shred A Billion?
faq.answer: You can play with up to three friends. If you're deciding who to invite, that makes four players including you, not three total. If you want a shared goal after getting started, the gold vault heist gives you a later objective with a leaderboard for the fastest runs.
